about_the_game:
The novelization of Memory's Dogma Code:01. Contains PDF/ePub versions in English and PDF version in Japanese.

STORY

With the recent advancements in information technology and neuroscience in Japan, human memories can now be saved and recorded via a technology called "e-Memory." While the government prohibits the digitization of the memories of the living, numerous state-operated facilities now exist that will allow one to communicate with the deceased: the "Connect Center."

College student Hiroki Kusuhara struggles with suicidal impulses after the sudden passing of his close childhood friend, Sorano Mizunashi. In order to accept the reality of Sorano's death, Hiroki goes to the Connect Center with his friend, Amamiya Kakeru but when they stand before Sorano's memory, what they witness is something inexplicable. With doubts surrounding the circumstances of her death, Hiroki and Kakeru decide to try and steal Sorano's memories. In the midst of this, Hiroki meets a mysterious girl named Reina and becomes embroiled in a battle involving a secret hidden within humanity.

STAFF LIST

Author: Wataru Takahashi
Illustrator: Picpicgram
Scenario Assistant: Michiho Fujimura, Youichi Hiragino
Original Work: LizArts

Translation: John Raymond Lim
Typesetting: Miranda Garza

short_description: The first volume in the novelization of Memory's Dogma Code:01. Japan, 2030 A.D. Memories can now be digitized and archived, allowing people to communicate with the deceased. With only one week left before his best friend’s memories are deleted, can Hiroki uncover the truth behind Sorano’s death?
